name: ecoh
description: E. coli O and H antigens (srst2 EcOH)

references.citation: Inouye M, Dashnow H, Raven LA, Schultz MB, Pope BJ, Tomita T, et al. SRST2: Rapid genomic surveillance for public health and hospital microbiology labs. Genome Med 2014;6(11):90.
references.note: The SRST2 tool whose EcOH scheme this snapshot is: O and H antigen allele panels for E. coli serotyping from short reads or assemblies.

caveats: In-silico serotyping is not agglutination: some O groups share their antigen genes and cannot be separated by sequence alone, so an O-type call narrows the serotype rather than certifying it.
H (flagellar) antigen calls follow fliC allele similarity. Phase variation and non-flagellate or fliC-divergent isolates can yield no H call even though the strain is typeable in the wet lab.
Serotype is not pathotype: an O157 or O26 call says nothing about Shiga toxin carriage or virulence. Screen a pathotype panel (ecoli_dec) alongside.
The panel is a point-in-time snapshot. `gapit db fetch ecoh` re-downloads the current srst2 upstream; alleles added since the snapshot date only arrive that way.
